content.title: Miniature Guide | Repeated Appearances Lead to a Material Echo
content.summary: Use a small non-verbal guide to first attract attention, and then let it reappear in different spatial holes or road signs, driving the subject and the camera to go deeper along a continuous route; the final destination entered by the guide fulfills the previous promise with the same material, shape or color echo.

quick_start.input_format: Small non-verbal guide + Continuously follow the route + At least two holes appear + The guide enters the end first + Material or graphic echo
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original paper art archive, the young archivist stopped next to the walnut bookshelf. An indigo glowing paper moth the size of a palm appeared at hand, and the first circular bookshelf window in front was visible; the paper moth reappeared from the second round hole and passed through a folding catalog door, and the archivist followed in the same direction; the wall picture only lit up once, and the same indigo branching pattern as the paper moth's wings unfolded, and the guide, map and archivist remained in the same frame.
required_anchors: Establish one small moving guide and its scale relation before the destination is known.
Keep guide, follower and route direction spatially connected during movement.
Let the guide enter or indicate the final destination before the follower arrives.
Echo one established guide property in the destination result.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Use a small non-verbal guide to first attract attention, and then let it reappear in different spatial holes or road signs, driving the subject and the camera to go deeper along a continuous route; the final destination entered by the guide fulfills the previous promise with the same material, shape or color echo.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Introduce one small nonverbal guide, let it repeatedly appear at spatially connected markers while a follower or camera advances, and end at a destination whose material, shape or color visibly echoes the guide's established identity.

invariants.rule: Establish one small moving guide and its scale relation before the destination is known.
invariants.ablation_failure: A destination-first opening removes the guide's purpose.

invariants.rule: Keep guide, follower and route direction spatially connected during movement.
invariants.purpose: Makes the journey continuous rather than a montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated locations turn reappearances into teleportation.

invariants.rule: Use at least two recurring apertures or landmarks as route-progress proofs.
Let the guide enter or indicate the final destination before the follower arrives.
invariants.purpose: Converts motion into an earned endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: A follower arriving first makes the guide irrelevant.

invariants.rule: Echo one established guide property in the destination result.
invariants.purpose: Pays off the guide's visual identity without dialogue.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated endpoint makes the route arbitrary.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact bee-follow route and warm food palette
